{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./gnn_2_1.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   --ntasks=1          -> -n 1
#   --time=48:00:00     -> -t 48h
#   --mem=16G           -> (not translated; see note)
#   --gres=gpu:32gb:1   -> -g 1  (GPU type/memory constraint not translated)
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 1 -g 1 -t 48h --wrap "bash $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: Slurm --job-name=gnn_2_1 not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance is unaffected.

  # NOTE: Slurm --partition=main not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible resources; you are not forcing the main partition.

  # NOTE: Slurm --mem=16G not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a memory reservation/limit, the job may contend for memory or be OOM-killed, affecting reliability/performance.

  # NOTE: Slurm requested GPU type/memory (gpu:32gb:1). Flux portable request only expresses GPU count (-g 1).
  # Performance implication: job may run on a GPU with different memory size/performance characteristics.

  export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
  module load cuda/10.2
  module load anaconda
  conda activate diffsub

  flux run -n 1 -g 1 python main.py with configs/zinc/node_del/del1_subgraph1_imle.yaml
fi
"
}
